title: Cleft
summary: CLEFT, participle passive of cleave. Divided; split; parted asunder. CLEFT, noun 1. A space or opening made by splitting; a crack; a crevice; as the cleft of a rock. Isaiah 2:21. 2. A disease in horse

inlines.v: CLEFT, participle passive of cleave. Divided; split; parted asunder. CLEFT, noun 1. A space or opening made by splitting; a crack; a crevice; as the cleft of a rock. Isaiah 2:21. 2. A disease in horses; a crack on the bought of the pastern. 3. A piece made by splitting; as a cleft of wood.
